title: Ride-On Through Bolton
subject: a council grounds worker in Bolton who mows the roundabouts and grass verges on a ride-on mower every summer, waves at the same bus driver at the same roundabout each morning, and spares one patch of wild orchids on the ring road verge that she tapes off with her own bunting
caption: Northern soul, mid-60s Detroit-style stomper as played at UK allnighters. Stomping four-on-the-floor drums with tambourine on every beat, bright brass section stabs, a driving melodic electric bass, chiming vibraphone and choppy rhythm guitar. Compressed mid-60s mix, warm tape hiss, room reverb on the brass. Female soul vocal with a strong gritty chest voice, backing singers answering in call and response. 112 BPM, E-flat major. Driving, proud and high-spirited. No modern pop drums, no autotune, no synths, no hip-hop beat, no slow ballad section.
lyrics:
[Intro - tambourine and stomp, brass stab, vibraphone]

[Verse 1]
Seven a.m. at the Beehive roundabout
Ear defenders on and the choke pulled out
The 501 goes by with Terry at the wheel
He gives two toots and I wave from behind the wheel

[Pre-Chorus]
Cut the grass, cut the grass (cut it low)
Round and round, there I go

[Chorus]
Ride-on through Bolton, four miles an hour
Stripes on the verges like a wedding flower
Everybody honks when I'm passing by
Council green and a big blue sky

[Verse 2]
Out on the ring road near the Asda sign
There's purple orchids growing in a crooked line
I stopped my engine and I counted nine
Then I taped off the patch with bunting of mine

[Pre-Chorus]
Go round it, go round it (don't you dare)
The council knows I put it there

[Chorus]
Ride-on through Bolton, four miles an hour
Stripes on the verges round an orchid flower
Everybody honks when I'm passing by
Council green and a big blue sky

[Bridge - drums and handclaps, brass build]
Terry slowed the bus down just to see
Nine little orchids and the bunting and me

[Chorus]
Ride-on through Bolton, four miles an hour
Terry's got his passengers waving at the flowers
Everybody honks when I'm passing by
Council green and a big blue sky

[Outro - brass and tambourine vamp, fade]
